Completed the assigned QFT-F03 A/B pair and its batch evidence. The A-page proof now derives the explicit \(2\pi\) spinor sign; the B example proves invariance of the norm-closed even smeared-field algebra.

All three item readiness records are **escalated**, not ready: the QFT-F01 postulate carrier is present but escalated, QFT-C01 lacks a current unit-supplier receipt, and the Dirac projection, CAR-locality and covariance chains remain unresolved upstream.

**Checks passed:** precheck and scoped proof-contract checks for all three items; proof-layout (3 items, 9 steps, 0 defects); rendercheck, content-policy, coverage checklist and focused dependency/cycle checks. The batch dependency levels passed an immediate write/check, though a later standalone check went stale as run-wide manifests changed. Whole-run dependency checks still report unrelated empty inventories and stale levels; whole-run contract coverage stops at an empty `rpm-external-charge-examples` inventory. The run’s blocker record lists a stage stalemate outside batch 57.

The batch notes record the plan conflict, dependency review, source recovery history and check results. Sources inspected include [Tong, Chapter 4](https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/qft/qfthtml/S4.html), [Tong, Chapter 5](https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/qft/qfthtml/S5.html), and [Beisert’s complete 2025 QFT-I notes](https://people.phys.ethz.ch/~nbeisert/lectures/QFT1-25HS-Notes.pdf). Source coverage resolves all 10 entries: six active fetch stamps and four documented drops after the permitted retries.
